parts.description: Door mirror assembly LH
parts.notes: Eng no. BM51-17683-KF (BM51-17683-EF also listed as superseded). Listings describe heated, power-fold units, one with puddle lamp and one with blind-spot; exact feature set for this number not settled. Seen on 2011-2015 and 2016 donor listings; Ford UK lists 2309407 as 'Focus Mk3 N/S Door Rear View Mirror Housing 2011-2018'.

parts.description: TPMS sensor
parts.notes: Eng no. EV6T-1A180-DE. eBay listing 'Tyre Pressure TPMS Sensor Ford Focus Mk3 2012 to 2018 2562276 Genuine New OEM'. EV6T-1A180-CB is also listed against Focus Mk3 by globalparts (no Finis seen). Ford UK multi-fit service sensor 2859755 lists a Focus entry from 01/2011 (end date not seen). Only for direct-TPMS cars.
